answer: Require every agent to earn a costly reputation signal before it can claim full rewards. New identities start in a frozen tundra: they may do small, verifiable jobs, but the nectar of high-value work stays locked until a history of honest attestations accumulates. Creating a thousand fake identities then buys nothing, because each one must separately pay the same slow, expensive climb out of the cold, and any fraud burns the stake behind that identity.
